text: shinypak assumes GitHub RStudio (Positron) synced. can read setting gert package website: “gert, authentication done automatically using credentials package. package calls local OS credential store also used git command line. Therefore gert automatically pick https credentials safely stored OS keychain.”

title: shinypak
text: authenticating GitHub, typical workflow shinypak : Install load package Find example application chapter follow along (’ll use 02.3_proj-app). Confirm branch name list_apps(). Supplying regex returns branches matching particular chapter topic: launch app Shiny App-Packages book, can supply name branch launch(): example, 02.3_proj-app branch comes early chapters Shiny App-Packages, app isn’t quite app-package yet: launch() check application already downloaded, download application files folder current working directory, launch app: branch storing app-package, launch() loads package launches application:  ’d prefer download application without launching , call get_app(). branch downloaded current working directory:  Supply open = TRUE open new project fresh IDE session:  app already downloaded, files updated latest commit branch.
code: install.packages('pak') pak::pak("mjfrigaard/shinypak", force = TRUE) library(shinypak) list_apps(regex = "^02.3")  #>          branch        last_updated #> 5 02.3_proj-app 2025-03-11 13:43:18 list_apps(regex = "proj-app")  #>          branch        last_updated #> 5 02.3_proj-app 2025-03-11 13:43:18 launch(app = "<branch>") launch(app = "02.3_proj-app") ✔ '02.3_proj-app' not in local working directory [59ms] ✔ downloading '02.3_proj-app' [10.7s]  ✔ got '02.3_proj-app' [163ms]          ✔ Launching app with: shiny::shinyAppDir('02.3_proj-app/app.R') get_app(app = "05_roxygen2") get_app(app = "05_roxygen2", open = TRUE)

title: shinypak
text: every folder DESCRIPTION file R package, every .Rproj file configured package development. is_r_package() checks . Consider three folders : folder contains R package, is_r_package() returns TRUE. Setting verbose = TRUE prints details check: verbose output tells ’s missing, just whether check failed. Consider app folder, DESCRIPTION .Rproj file: tells us app missing fields DESCRIPTION, .Rproj file isn’t configured RStudio’s build tools.
